card.name: Verb before kidney-harm warnings with ARBs
card.fires_on: The word "may" or "increased" right after a list of drugs acting on the renin-angiotensin system (ARBs, ACE inhibitors, aliskiren, NSAIDs). It sits just before a warning about kidney function, low blood pressure or high potassium.

modes.label: NSAID plus ARB interaction
modes.description: "may" after an ARB name in the NSAID interaction warning, just before "result in deterioration of renal function".
modes.example: IDs, including selective COX-2 inhibitors, with angiotensin II receptor antagonists, including olmesartan medoxomil,<< may>> result in deterioration of renal function, including

modes.label: Dual RAS blockade
modes.description: "increased" after "is associated with" in the dual blockade warning, before the list of risks.
modes.example: System (RAS) : Dual blockade of the RAS with angiotensin receptor blockers, ACE inhibitors, or aliskiren is associated with<< increased>> risks of hypotension, hyperk

card.plain: It marks the verb that leads into the standard warning about kidney problems when blood pressure drugs are combined.
